column1: # Slice 299, try a02: a01's three frontend modules, now with the check marking a method whose reception it admits by an
# unavailable route on the status channel (lm_compiler_unavailable_route_mark: p299c's caller aborted on "a callable that
# cannot throw reported a status"), and the registry's migration -- index_numeric_refused and index_numeric_write_refused
# become index_numeric_unavailable, var_own_repeat_norecv_refused becomes var_own_repeat_unavailable, the new fixture
# numeric_unavailable_route; inputs.list keeps 235 inputs.  The candidate stage cold-tp140, by `lmxtool steps` with the
# working tool of boot160a: the changed files pinned, kept in variants/tp161 (a02 replaces a01's copies) and copied into
# the stage; the source manifest of the stage by the inputs list written, then checked against the working copy.
